_about: Accounts a human confirmed are real players, not farm accounts. The padding filter (padding.mjs isFarmVictim) never treats them as farm victims, so kills on them count again and they never cause a * or † mark. Keyed by bare character name (lowercase, no outfit tag); cid is checked too when a row carries one. Add entries by hand: "name": { "cid": "…", "reason": "why", "at": "YYYY-MM-DD" }.
